name: Repliii Chatbot
author: ppsanil

sections.description:
Repliii, from www.repliii.com is a simple, powerful AI chatbot that responds to text content that the user can define themselves.
It can be embedded on any website. This plugin makes it effortless for WordPress users by automatically inserting the required script tags.

Features:
* Add your Repliii chatbot without touching code
* Enter your User ID in a simple settings page
* Enable/Disable the chatbot with one click
* Advanced customization options:
– Button color
– Button opacity
– Header title & colors
– Placeholder text
– Custom SVG logo
* Lightweight — no performance impact

Privacy & Third-Party Service Disclaimer

This plugin relies on the Repliii AI service to provide chatbot functionality.
To ensure you always have the latest features and security patches, this plugin loads the chatbot script directly from our servers rather than bundling it locally.

  • Service Used: Repliii AI
  • Data Sent: User chat messages and interaction data are sent to Repliii APIs for processing.
  • Service Provider: XF Systems Ltd.
  • Script Source: https://www.repliii.com/assets/bot.js
  • Source Code: https://github.com/psanilp/xfbot (The client-side script is open source for transparency).
  • Privacy Policy: https://repliii.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://repliii.com/terms

By using this plugin, you agree to the use of this third-party service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/repliii-chatbot/
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu
  3. Go to Settings → Repliii Chatbot
  4. Enter your User ID
  5. Save changes
sections.faq:
Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Just paste your User ID.

Where do I get my User ID?

From your Repliii dashboard at https://repliii.com

Where do I set content for the AI chatbot?

From your Repliii dashboard at https://repliii.com

Does this slow down my site?

No. The script loads asynchronously.
